title: Fugaro models ls
description: The document `fugaro models ls --json` prints: the routes of the selected project (the owner's providers and the direct Anthropic route), every model a run can name today with the route that serves it and where its price comes from, and the pins of each repository the project records. The read is offline: what it says about the cloud is what the local files already say. Members are only ever added within a version (D848), so a renamed or re-meant member is a new member under a new name and the old one is kept, and removing or retyping one bumps version. No object here is closed for that reason: additionalProperties is left true everywhere, because a consumer that refused a member this schema does not know would refuse a newer CLI's document, which D848 promises to keep readable under the same version.

project.description: The selected project's name. Absent when no project config was selected, which leaves routes holding the direct route alone and repositories empty.

catalog.description: The built-in provider price catalog's own provenance. Absent when no model in the document is priced from it.

routes.description: The routes of this project: the direct Anthropic route first, then the owner's providers in name order.

models.description: Every model a run can name today, in ID order: an ID a route claims, a model_prices key, a budget.allowed_models entry and a model a repository pins.

repositories.description: One row per repository the project records, in name order. A repository this machine has no checkout for is `unknown (no checkout on this machine)`: its row is not guessed at (D793).

source.description: The catalog's own source URL, which is not the embedded Claude table's.

checked_at.description: The day the catalog was generated, YYYY-MM-DD.

age_days.description: How many whole days old checked_at is at the moment of the read.

stale.description: checked_at is past catalog.StaleAfter (30 days): every model the catalog prices is then charged the dearest end of its tier's range (design D10).

name.description: The provider entry's name in the project config, or `direct` for the Anthropic API itself (config.RouteDirect).

kind.description: The provider entry's kind, `anthropic-compat` today; `anthropic` on the direct route.

base_url.description: The provider entry's base_url, or the Anthropic API's own on the direct route.

host.description: The host of base_url: what a reader recognises the route by. The base_url itself when it names no host.

models.description: The models the route claims, as written: exact IDs or a prefix ending in *. The direct route's are the embedded Claude table's own IDs.

route_fee_pct.description: route_fee_pct: what is added to every charge on this route. Absent when the route charges none.

allow_data_to.description: The repositories whose code may be sent here, as written, or ["*"] for a route open to every repository (the direct route included, which no allow_data_to governs).

open_to_every_repo.description: config.ModelProvider.OpenToEveryRepo: the entry has no allow_data_to at all, or the explicit ["*"] marker.

note.description: What the entry's own keys do not say: the routing.claude switch on the direct route, and a route's require_zdr on its own row.

route.description: The route a run would send this model down: the provider whose models claim it, the route routing.claude sends it to, or `direct` for a Claude ID nothing routes. Empty is a model no route of this project serves, which a launch refuses (spec §2.2).

source.description: Where the price comes from: this binary's Claude table, the built-in provider price catalog, the owner's model_prices, or nothing at all — the last has no price row, and refused says why.

input_per_m.description: US dollars per million input tokens. Absent on a row whose price is zero or unknown: a consumer reads `source` before it reads a price.

output_per_m.description: US dollars per million output tokens. Absent on a row whose price is zero or unknown.

catalog.description: A catalog-priced row's own provenance: the tier, the end of its range charged and the endpoints behind it. Absent on every other row.

allowed_to.description: The repositories this model may be used by: [] when nothing serves it, [] when the project's budget.allowed_models leaves it out, ["*"] on the direct route, and otherwise the serving route's allow_data_to.

refused.description: Why the model has no price (pricing.Table.Refusal): the message that says what to do about it. Absent on a row that has one.

note.description: The spread a catalog-priced row is charged over — what the dearest endpoint of its tier prices, against the price charged (design D6, P11). Absent elsewhere.

tier.description: Which endpoint set the price is over: the ZDR-eligible endpoints, or every endpoint the model is served by.

bound.description: Which end of the tier's range is charged: the cheapest, or the dearest (price_policy: highest, or a stale catalog).

endpoints.description: How many endpoints the model is served by.

zdr_endpoints.description: How many of them are ZDR-eligible: the zdr tier's own count.

tier_input_max_per_m.description: The dearest input price per million tokens the charged tier prices.

tier_output_max_per_m.description: The dearest output price per million tokens the charged tier prices.

name.description: The repository's owner/name, as the project config records it.

state.description: `ok` when the checkout's fugaro.yaml at the base branch was read, `unknown (no checkout on this machine)` when there is none (D793), and `unread: <reason>` when there is one this read could not use.

coder.description: agent.models.coder, else agent.model. Absent unless the state is `ok`.

reviewer.description: agent.models.reviewer, else agent.model. Absent unless the state is `ok`.

background.description: The file's own agent.models.background. Absent when the file sets none.

background_effective.description: The model Claude Code's background requests actually reach when the file names none (config.EffectiveBackground). Absent when it is the same as background.

problems.description: The refusals a launch would give for this repository's pins (config.CheckProviderPolicy), each as the problem's own text.
